Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 124. Category: technique. Rank 1.

Rank 1 Melee technique
Ki Cost: 5 ki
Casting Time: When you take the attack action or
roll a Combo Attack Roll
Range: Self
Chargeable?: No
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Push your strikes even further using Ki. All unarmed
strikes deal 1 damage die higher for the duration.
(1d4>1d6>1d8>1d10>1d12>2d6,> etc)
